_comment: The Android TV page (android.html) is public. The Google Play link is not: it does not exist yet.
playLive: false until Google Play shows the Nostalgex listing (Chad confirms by opening the public
Play page). playUrl: null until then, and then it is the public Play listing link, nothing else.
There is no beta or join link on the site, and no date. `npm test` (android:check) fails if one
appears, or if the page, its footer link or its sitemap line go missing.
When Play shows the app, in order:
1. android.html: replace the .android-status line and the 'Is it on Google Play?' answer, and add the
Play button to the hero (and the home tile: drop the Coming soon sticker, say what it is).
2. Set playLive true and playUrl here.
3. scripts/android-section-check.mjs: flip it from 'link absent' to 'link present and exactly playUrl'.
No contributor names anywhere on the site (Chad, 2026-11-11). Credit is GitHub and Discord only.
